new_p1.title: 64-character look-behind truncates legal long product names

repro.input: Company launched the ExtremelyLongProductNameAlpha ExtremelyLongProductNameBeta ExtremelyLongProductNameGamma ExtremelyLongProductNameDelta device.

new_p1.impact: The Latin name regex allows up to 4 tokens and the contract has no 64-char cap; the truncation is accepted as a proper name and silently changes family/span, so a deictic can close to the wrong declaration. It is not a safe defer.
new_p1.fix: Expand look-behind to cover the maximum legal name (e.g. 256 chars), or detect a clipped name start and retry/defer; add a 4-token >64-char test plus a Chinese boundary test; rerun 105 tests and three-source replay.
